# Alex Rivera

Software engineer focused on accessible web applications and reliable APIs.

## Experience
- Software Engineering Intern, Civic Tech Lab (2025)
  - Built FastAPI endpoints and added pytest coverage for community-services data.
  - Improved a React search flow for keyboard and screen-reader users.

## Education
- B.S. in Computer Science, Lakeside University (Expected 2027)

## Skills
Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub Actions
